text:
Maya L.: quick brain-dump: proposing a pressure-adaptive demotion mode for the KV/prefix cache. goal: protect p99 for critical tenants during memory pressure by progressively degrading residency and throttling refill pressure.
Diego R.: sounds promising. how do we pick who gets degraded? avoid flip-flopping between states.
Maya L.: prioritize by tenant QoS class + recent hotness. add hysteresis windows per-tenant and per-prefix so we don't thrash.
Arjun K.: idea: introduce a demote_token (versioned) on the prefix metadata. nodes set token when they demote payloads. readers compare token to their last_seen_token and gate reads/retries accordingly. reduces stale-read ambiguity.
Priya S.: critical: demote_token must be tied to the lease/epoch to avoid races during ownership handoffs. otherwise node A demotes, node B takes ownership and rebuilds, but stale token confuses readers. require (lease_epoch, demote_token) CAS semantics.
Sam (oncall): ops concerns: if many entries demote we will see spike in datastore fetch QPS and increased GPU-to-CPU stalls. need a post-demote admission limiter that caps concurrent refill requests per-node and per-tenant.
Diego R.: scoring tweak: hotness = recent_hits_decay + manual_priority_boost; eviction_score = hotness / (resident_pages ^ beta). demote lowers effective hotness rather than immediately removing entries.
Maya L.: candidate state machine: CACHED_FULL -> PAYLOAD_DEMOTED (value buffers freed, keys+index kept) -> INDEX_ONLY (even key metadata evicted to cold slab) -> REMOVED. transitions always annotate (lease_epoch, demote_token, tombstone_ts).
Arjun K.: for re-fetch gate: readers should check prefix meta for demote_token; if token changed and reader is the writer in-flight, it should either re-validate via quick CAS or block briefly and refetch. Provide a non-blocking fast-path that tries a bounded number of retries before issuing a fetch.
Priya S.: testing/invariants we need: 1) RYW: a write that completes must be visible to following reads even if demote happens concurrently; 2) No read-after-demote stale reads: readers must either see new value or trigger refetch; 3) Handoff-safety: demote+handoff atomicity wrt lease-epoch. We'll draft small litmus cases for each.
Sam (oncall): telemetry plan: metrics: demotes/sec (by level), demote_token_changes/sec, post_demote_refetch_p50/95/99, refill_rate_per_tenant, admission_denied_count. Dashboard: per-tenant occupancy timeline with demote states annotated.
Diego R.: also watch memory fragmentation and slab churn. probe a periodic gentle compaction pass after major demote windows. maybe do compaction during low-QPS windows.
Maya L.: operational policy: soft demote (PAYLOAD_DEMOTED) is reversible for grace_secs. if a prefix gets hot again within grace window we rebuild payload locally; if not, escalate to INDEX_ONLY. This keeps short bursts cheap.
Arjun K.: locking note: demote ops must be idempotent. if two nodes concurrently issue demote with different tokens, the higher (lease_epoch, token) wins and older demote is a no-op.\nPriya S.: test matrix: single-writer RYW under demote, concurrent writers with handoff+demote, demote_token expiry races, bounded-retry reader behavior, admission limiter stress. Need unit + integration + chaos fuzz.
Maya L.: spike plan: implement demote_token in prefix proto, add PAYLOAD_DEMOTED state, quick re-fetch gate logic, and admission limiter. run chaos sim: burst surges + slow datastore. collect p50/p95/p99 and refill QPS.
Sam (oncall): I can wire dashboards and add admission limiter knobs to canary runbook. Also add alert if post_demote_refetch_p99 > threshold or if refill_rate spikes above baseline.
Diego R.: I'll prototype scoring and hysteresis windows, plus compaction trigger heuristics.
Priya S.: I'll write the safety invariants and produce litmus tests.
ops-bot: created ephemeral stream for testing: metrics/pressure_adaptive_demote/test-stream (expires 24h).
Maya L.: volunteers: Diego + Arjun for proto + scoring spike, Priya for invariants, Sam for telemetry/canary. Sync in 72h. Follow-ups: proto change, admission limiter, demote_token litmus harness, compaction schedule. :thumbsup:
